analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Oct 22nd at noon EST
key_insights: Based on performance estimates from the GS prime book at noon EST on Oct 22, 2026, roughly two-thirds of hedge funds are down on the day, a worse day than last Thursday (Oct 15).
Momentum fell 2.6 SD and Crowded Longs fell 2.8 SD, the worst daily sell-off since the week of Liberation Day in April 2025.
For the first time since COVID, all three broad equity hedge fund strategies (Global Fundamental L/S, Global Systematic L/S, Multi-Strats) fell more than 1% on the same day.
Global Fundamental L/S managers are down 1.1% (-1.7 SD), driven primarily by beta, and down 3.5% MTD, still up 9.1% YTD.
Asia-focused funds are down 1.7% (-1.3 SD) and 8.8% MTD, still up 14.6% YTD. TMT-focused funds are down 1.8% (-1.3 SD) and 8.6% MTD, still up 9.0% YTD.
Global Systematic L/S managers are down 1.2% (-3.2 SD) with losses across all regions, driven by Momentum and Crowded Longs. They remain up 19.1% YTD.
Multi-Strats (equity portfolio, 4.5x leverage) are down 1.4% (-2.5 SD). Momentum, Info Tech and Crowded Longs are the largest factor detractors.
Oct 15 close: Global Fundamental L/S down 0.5% (-0.8 SD), up 10% YTD. Global Systematic L/S down 1.4% (-3.7 SD), the worst day since Aug 19, and still up 20% YTD. Multi-Strats down 1.2% (-2.2 SD).
Oct 15 at 10:30am EST, during an AI sell-off: Momentum fell 3.4 SD and Crowded Longs fell 1.8 SD, while Crowded Shorts squeezed +1.2 SD, which GS reads as broader de-grossing.
From COVID through end-2025, all three broad strategies never fell more than 80bps on the same day. In 2026 it has happened three times: 4-Feb, 28-Jul and Oct 15.
risk_factors: Further de-grossing and factor unwinds in Momentum and Crowded Longs, as seen on Oct 15 and Oct 22.
Simultaneous drawdowns across fundamental, systematic and multi-strat strategies, which has happened three times in 2026 after not happening from COVID through end-2025.
Concentrated pain in Asia-focused and TMT-focused funds, down 8.8% and 8.6% MTD respectively.
vol_and_positioning: Momentum factor -2.6 SD and Crowded Longs factor -2.8 SD on Oct 22 at noon EST, the worst daily sell-off since the week of Liberation Day in April 2025.
On Oct 15 Crowded Shorts squeezed +1.2 SD while Momentum fell 3.4 SD and Crowded Longs fell 1.8 SD, which GS reads as broader de-grossing.
Roughly two-thirds of hedge funds are down on Oct 22, and Global Fundamental L/S losses are driven primarily by beta.
Asia-focused funds are 23% off their late-June peak of +40% YTD as of Oct 15 (up 17% YTD then).
